title: Flat-term K-flat completed-coefficient complexes
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and let $W$ be any scheme with completed integral coefficient sheaf $R_W$ on its small pro-etale site [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. A cochain complex $P$ of $R_W$-modules [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] is good if and only if it is K-flat in the sense of [def-pc-kflat-complex] and every term $P^i$, for every $i\in\mathbf Z$, is flat in the sense of [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]. This is an object predicate; its full subcategory has all chain maps between such complexes. There is no boundedness or constructibility condition and no relation between the coefficient and scheme universes.
